sentence: Split shaft collar for 8 mm with an M4 cap screw: counterbore one side, tapped the other
design_notes: Ring 24 x 8 x 10 with a 1 mm split; screw axis along y at x = 8: counterbore 8 dia to y = -4.5 (DIN 974-1 for ISO 4762 M4), clearance 4.5, tap drill 3.3 with an M4 6H callout.
